Build something extraordinary, collaborate with peers, and compete for exclusive premium AI subscriptions. Guidelines: Eligibility: Open exclusively and completely free of cost to all current students. Format: Online software development hackathon requiring a working prototype, a presentation, and code submission. Team Composition: Teams must consist of 2 to 6 members. October 11: 36-hour hack starts October 13: Final submission deadline at 11:59 PM. October 14–16: Official judging window. Rules: Every participant must be an actively enrolled student. All project builds must correspond directly to one of the provided problem statements. Submissions must be completed before the October 13th (11:59 PM) deadline; late entries will not be accommodated. To qualify for the additional Social Media Engagement prize (Claude Premium subscription), teams must publicly share their project, properly tag Erazone, and generate measurable engagement.

raw.details:
Welcome to HackEra 1.0, Erazone's inaugural student hackathon designed to turn your ideas into real impact. Build something extraordinary, collaborate with peers, and compete for exclusive premium AI subscriptions.

Guidelines:

  • Eligibility: Open exclusively and completely free of cost to all current students.
  • Format: Online software development hackathon requiring a working prototype, a presentation, and code submission.
  • Team Composition: Teams must consist of 2 to 6 members. Both inter-college and inter-specialization team configurations are fully allowed and encouraged.
  • Problem Statements: Participants will receive the official problem statements at the end of the registration period on October 11th.

Timeline & Duration:

  • October 11: Problem statements distributed to all registered participants.
  • October 11: 36-hour hack starts
  • October 13: Final submission deadline at 11:59 PM.
  • October 14–16: Official judging window.

Rules:

  • Every participant must be an actively enrolled student.
  • All project builds must correspond directly to one of the provided problem statements.
  • Final submissions are strictly required to include three elements: a Git repository link, a presentation (PPT), and a prototype demonstration video.
  • Submissions must be completed before the October 13th (11:59 PM) deadline; late entries will not be accommodated.
  • To qualify for the additional Social Media Engagement prize (Claude Premium subscription), teams must publicly share their project, properly tag Erazone, and generate measurable engagement.
